subsystems.name: Training compute cluster
subsystems.role: supplies the raw arithmetic for training and serving a very large model.

subsystems.name: Data pipeline
subsystems.role: turns raw text, code, images and audio into clean training material.

subsystems.name: Model architecture
subsystems.role: the mathematical structure that learns and stores patterns.

subsystems.name: Learning algorithms
subsystems.role: the procedures that turn data into capability.

subsystems.name: Agent and tool layer
subsystems.role: lets the model act over time rather than answer one prompt.

subsystems.name: Evaluation and safety harness
subsystems.role: measures what the system can do and limits what it may do.

buildSteps.title: Define the target
buildSteps.detail: Write down the capabilities that count as 'general' and the evaluations that would show them, before training starts.

buildSteps.title: Assemble data and compute
buildSteps.detail: Gather and filter corpora, build or rent a cluster with tens of thousands of accelerators, and secure the electricity and cooling to run it.

buildSteps.title: Pretrain the base model
buildSteps.detail: Train a large neural network to predict missing parts of data, an objective that forces it to absorb structure across many domains.

buildSteps.title: Post-train for behaviour
buildSteps.detail: Use reinforcement learning on tasks with checkable answers, plus human and AI feedback, to make the model useful and obedient to instructions.

buildSteps.title: Add memory and tools
buildSteps.detail: Give the system persistent memory, retrieval over documents, and the ability to call software — essential for long, multi-step work.

buildSteps.title: Scale up agency
buildSteps.detail: Let the model plan, act, observe results and correct itself in loops, with sandboxing so mistakes stay contained.

buildSteps.title: Evaluate and red-team
buildSteps.detail: Test for transfer to unseen domains, deception, and dangerous capabilities; investigate the internals to check it is doing what it claims.

buildSteps.title: Deploy under oversight
buildSteps.detail: Serve the system with monitoring, human review at high-stakes decision points, and the ability to roll back.

prerequisites.tech: Frontier-scale compute and its supply chain
prerequisites.why: training runs already use thousands of accelerators; general capability may need far more.
readily available human text is being exhausted, and synthetic data can amplify errors.
today's models are largely frozen after training and need far more examples than a person to learn a new skill.
without it, we cannot verify whether a system's reasoning is genuine or safe.
benchmarks are quickly saturated or gamed, so 'general' progress is hard to measure honestly.

pathway.milestone: multimodal models that write, code, see and hold long conversations, wrapped in early agent scaffolding
pathway.unlocks: useful automation of bounded, checkable tasks.

pathway.milestone: agents that complete multi-hour or multi-day projects with memory and tool use
pathway.unlocks: delegation of real knowledge work under human supervision.

pathway.milestone: systems that transfer a new skill learned in one domain to another with little extra data
pathway.unlocks: the practical definition of 'general' that most researchers would accept.

pathway.milestone: reliable, interpretable systems with governance agreed across borders
pathway.unlocks: wide deployment — and the reason to be cautious about the pace.
